findings.description: [00-desk-light.png] Desktop light (830px): Tagline, one-line intro, and link row sit cleanly at top. 'Selected work' WebP (800x360) anchors the page immediately below with centered project links. 'Now' renders as one unified 800x512 dark bento SVG aligned with the showcase width: full-width GITHUB ACTIVITY header panel (no clipping on 30d honesty note or dual timestamps), side-by-side DISCORD ('presence stale' / 'presence stale or unavailable' — no mid-word truncation) and DECLARED FOCUS (clean header-to-bullet gap and footer clearance), and 4 well-padded stat cells (34,138 / 204 / 204 / TypeScript 45%) with zero border crossing. 'GitHub activity' aligns cleanly at 800px: left panel hero '4,364' aligns with 6 active repo rows with generous bar/icon pitch; '8 private repos (aggregated): 1,490 commits · 548 PRs' fits completely with right margin; right panel shows 7 deduplicated events with humanised status ('closed'/'open') and timestamps neatly on line 2 with zero truncation. 'Stack' renders 5 balanced centered rows using light-theme skill icons.

[01-desk-dark.png] Desktop dark (830px): Page chrome, links, and Stack skill icons properly switch to dark variants. Both '/now' and '/activity' dark SVGs display a crisp 1px panelStroke border that clearly defines their edges against GitHub's #0d1117 background. All text, numbers, status indicators, and alignments match desktop light with strong legibility.

[02-mob-light.png] Mobile light (390px): Both '/now' and '/activity' cleanly serve their stacked 560px mobile variants via <picture>. '/now' stacks GITHUB ACTIVITY (short honest 30d copy + single observed timestamp, zero mid-word truncation) -> DISCORD ('presence stale or unavailable') -> DECLARED FOCUS (expanded 168px panel gives clean bottom clearance below 'declared · rebuildup.dev') -> 2x2 stat grid with highly legible text. '/activity' stacks EVENTS BY REPOSITORY (hero '4,364' clearly separated below panel label; 6 active repos only with zero-event rows removed; private-repo footnote fits cleanly) -> RECENT ACTIVITY (all 7 deduplicated rows fit full labels + right-aligned timestamps on single lines with zero overlap/truncation) -> outer footer with generous bottom padding. 'Stack' wraps cleanly across categories.

[03-mob-dark.png] Mobile dark (390px): Stacked mobile '/now' and '/activity' SVGs render with clear 1px outer borders separating them from the dark background, and 'Stack' switches to dark-themed icons. Vertical rhythm and legibility match mobile light with no overflow or clipping.

[Polish #1 — Desktop /activity footnote clearance] In 00-desk-light.png and 01-desk-dark.png, the 7th RECENT ACTIVITY timestamp ('Nov 24 · 16:32 JST' under 'herdr-t3 · Issue #154 · open') sits very close (~2–3px) above the bottom-right 'times in JST' footnote, and in the left panel 'bars: public repos only' sits fairly close beneath the private-repo footnote. Adding ~4–6px of inner panel bottom clearance would relax both corners.

[Polish #2 — Mobile /activity muted metadata size & /now focus spacing] In 02-mob-light.png and 03-mob-dark.png, muted footnote lines inside '/activity' ('8 private repos (aggregated): 1,490 commits · 548 PRs', 'bars: public repos only', and outer 'observed Nov 24, 2026 · 16:41 JST · rebuildup.dev') render noticeably smaller and dimmer than '/now' metadata at 390px width. In mobile '/now' DECLARED FOCUS, while outer bottom padding is fixed, the gap between the 4th bullet ('• AI coding agent') and 'declared · rebuildup.dev' remains slightly snug (~4px).

[Polish #3 — Desktop/mobile repo count parity] Desktop '/activity' includes '+24 more repositories' below the 6 repo bars, whereas mobile '/activity' omits that line when stripping zero-event rows, creating a minor informational mismatch between viewports.

[Known non-blocking limitations confirmed] 'Selected work' WebP has sharp 90-degree corners (subtle edge blending on dark mode compared to the 1px-bordered rounded SVGs); mobile 'Stack' Languages wraps to 7+7+1 leaving a single 'p5*' orphan icon on 390px widths; dark-themed SVGs are intentionally dark on light pages and read cleanly as framed cards.

verdict.summary: Overall verdict: ACCEPT. All 11 previous review findings and all 4 additional fixes from this round are verified fixed across desktop (830px) and mobile (390px) in both light and dark themes. Requirement verdicts: (1) Information hierarchy: MET — 'Selected work' anchors the top of the page and 'Now' surfaces active work immediately below without hunting; (2) Status intuitiveness: MET — color-coded status cues, typographic hierarchy, and bento framing communicate activity, stale Discord presence, declared focus, and stats at a glance; (3) Consistency: MET — '/now' and '/activity' share a unified dark bento visual language and aligned edges; (4) Mobile: MET — both '/now' and '/activity' serve stacked 560px single-column layouts with legible text, zero overflow/truncation, and clean vertical rhythm; (5) Light/dark: MET — dark SVGs read cleanly as intentional framed cards on light pages and have crisp 1px borders on dark pages, with dark-themed Stack icons; (6) Composition: MET — balanced proportions, consistent alignment, and '/now' reads as one coherent card. Top 3 optional polish items by impact: (1) Add 4–6px vertical clearance above 'times in JST' and 'bars: public repos only' in desktop '/activity'; (2) Slightly bump footnote font size/contrast in mobile '/activity' and add ~2–4px between the last bullet and footer in mobile '/now' DECLARED FOCUS; (3) Reconcile desktop vs mobile '+24 more repositories' omission in '/activity'.
